title: Assay of cell adhesion molecules in transfected cells grown in suspension
protocol: Prepare an exponential culture of Jurkat cells in complete medium (RPMI, 10% fetal bovine serum, gentamycin).
Seed 2 ml from a 5x10^5 cells/ml Jurkat cell suspension in 12 well-plates (i.e., 1x10^6 cells per well).
Combine 4.5 μg of each expression construct (or empty vector control) with 0.5 μg of EGFP plasmid.
In separate reactions, combine another 4.5 μg of each expression construct (or controls as appropriate) with 0.5 μg of Ds-Red plasmid.
Prepare Fugene6 dilution by combining 12 μl of Fugene6 (per transfected well) with 160 μl of serum- and antibiotic-free RPMI medium, leave to activate at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 170 μl of Fugene6 dilution to each DNA mix, leave 15 min at room temperature.
Add each transfection mix drop-wise to a well with Jurkat cells.
Prepare a 48-well plate with 100 μl of serum-free RPMI containing antibiotics in each well.
Combine 100 μl of cell suspensions from the green and red series.
Add combined cell suspension to each of quadruplicate wells on the prepared 48-well plate.
Mix well and incubate in a CO₂ incubator for 2 days.
Resuspend cells by carefully shaking the plate side-to-side.
Spin the plate at low speed for 1 minute to pellet the cells.
Count manually under epifluorescence illumination (FITC and Rhodamine channels) the number of green and red cells.
Determine the proportion of each forming part of cell aggregates containing both green and red cells.
